candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Abrupt discontinuation of ACE inhibitor and initiation of ARB without documented baseline renal function or potassium, increasing risk of hyperkalemia or hypotension.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Confirm recent serum creatinine, eGFR, and potassium prior to losartan initiation and schedule follow-up within 1–2 weeks.
